shots.animation: Forty full-body drawings play in sequence as the boy climbs from the tree base onto the branch, then settles into hiding; the final pose holds while the nearer runner glides through the passage.

Three leaf planes sway on offset wind cycles as the camera eases toward the boy; the tree character reuses SH02's final fully drawn pose to preserve identity across the cut. The supplemental close-up remains archived and is not substituted for IMG-001.
A slow camera push finds the redrawn boy; he looks up, shades his eyes, scans the canopy, and takes a few cautious steps before holding.
Foreground and distant figures drift in opposite directions with visible parallax as the camera searches; the distant boy scans the tree, shifts his stance, and settles.
A deliberate dolly-in leaves the near bough and finds the seated boy; only a small branch-driven sway remains. No duplicate or ghost body.
Return to the empty courtyard, then slowly push toward the easy-to-miss boy in the canopy; hold on him and fade to black.
